clues.text: This city sits in the south centre of its land, in East Africa. It is the great trade hub for the whole east of the continent.
clues.narrowing: Puts the player in East Africa, in the south centre of one land.

source.quote: located in the south-central part of the country.

clues.text: This city sits close to the equator, yet its nights are cool. High ground cools the air, and the year splits into a wet time and a dry time.
clues.narrowing: Rules out hot lowland tropics; keeps a cool high city near the equator.

source.quote: Nairobi has a subtropical highland climate (Cwb). At 1,795 metres (5,889 ft) above sea level, evenings may be cool, especially in the June/July season, when the temperature can drop to 9 °C (48 °F).

clues.text: This town began in 1898 as a depot for the rail line. By 1907 it had grown to take the place of the old port as capital.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to young rail towns that took the capital job in 1907.

source.quote: The town quickly grew to replace Mombasa as the capital of Kenya in 1907.

clues.text: This is the only capital city in the world with a national park inside its bounds. You can leave the streets and step straight into wild park land.
clues.narrowing: Decisive: no other capital on Earth holds a national park inside it.

source.quote: Nairobi is uniquely notable for being the only capital city in the world that hosts a national park within its boundaries.

clues.text: The Parliament Buildings of Kenya stand in this city. The State House and the Supreme Court stand here too.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: Kenya's parliament, State House, and top court sit here.

source.quote: As the national capital, Nairobi is home to the Kenyan Parliament Buildings, the State House and the Supreme Court Building.

reveal.blurb: The town began in 1898 as a rail depot on the line inland. It took the capital job in 1907, and kept it when the land won its freedom in 1963. Today it is a great trade hub, famed for the wild park inside its bounds. Nairobi is the capital of Kenya.
